messages.text: Not sure

Still no BitFortun firmware fix, so the BS-2's off sale with the BS-4. What you can buy today: the Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s, about $41 of power a month at Lagos's 14¢.

Want me to run its sats and block odds?
someone told me that the BS-4 will drop today?
Read the bitfortun bs 4 page

No. I just checked the live listing and it's still not buyable — the drop is mid-October, no day announced yet. Whoever said today was guessing.

Also worth knowing: the listing now reads 18 TH/s, not 22, $599.99, ~300 W. That's the corrected figure after the firmware fix.

You're already on my list for the drop day. Want the B30 numbers meanwhile?
oh i see.
Ran the power-cost calculator · 14¢/kWh

Here's where it lands for Lagos, Henry. The Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405 W: about $41 of power a month at 14¢, and it stacks roughly 43,000 sats against that.

What you're really buying is a draw at a full block every ten minutes, for years, plus a real node of the network on your desk. Ships Nov 30.

Want me to put one in a cart?
so 18TH/s at stock right?

Yes, 18 TH/s is the stock rating, 4x BM1373 at about 300 W. That's the number the firmware fix is meant to make honest.

Don't plan on overclocking past it — it voids the warranty.

And to be clear, it's not in stock: the drop is mid-October.
whats on my mind is 2 units B-2, 2 units B-4 and 1 Thor P-2
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Used the planning-goals skill
Handed to the team · Multi-unit buyer over $2,000 with two SKUs off sale; needs Georges on drop timin

Only one of those three is buyable today: the Thor P2, $369, 10 TH/s at 166 W, so about $17 of power a month at Lagos's 14¢. Ships October 3. The B.2 and BS-4 are both off sale until BitFortun's firmware fix.

I've put the five-unit plan in front of Georges so he can line the BitFortun units up for you and clear the Nigeria checkout before the drop. The team picks it up Monday 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

Want me to cart the Thor P2 now, or hold the whole set together?
ok. but i want all to cart togeter when available

Understood, I'll keep the whole set on one order.

One honest thing: nobody can hold units through a drop, it sells to whoever checks out first. So the moment the BitFortun pages go live I'll build the cart with all five in it and send you the checkout link in one go.

Georges has your note either way, Monday 10am ET, confirmed by email.
sounds great thanks
Before you go, one thing I'm curious about: you keep coming back to the BitFortun units over the B30 I quoted — is that the water cooling, the 300 W, or something else?
lol, both water cooling and power

That makes sense, 300 W per unit in Lagos heat is the whole argument.

One more, then I'll leave you to it: where will the five of them actually run, a room in the house or somewhere like a garage or shop?
a room with an extractor fan

Good setup for five of them. I've noted the room and the fan with Georges so the BitFortun units get planned around it.

You're set: Monday 10am ET he picks it up, and I'll have the cart ready the day the drop opens. Enjoy your weekend, Henry.
you too. thanks
Anytime, Henry. Talk soon.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-2 numbers for where you live.
